name: Legal-services prices and jobs, monthly (BLS CPI, PPI and CES)
description: Month by month since 2017, what consumers pay for legal services (Consumer Price Index), what law offices receive for their work (Producer Price Index for offices of lawyers, overall and by type of work), and how many people work in legal services (Current Employment Statistics), each next to the all-items or services index where that helps. Every value is read from the Bureau of Labor Statistics' own database with its series id, base period, and a preliminary flag while BLS may still revise it. The consumer index measures a basket item, not a law firm's billing rate. Counts and index values only.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Legal-services prices and jobs, monthly (BLS CPI, PPI and CES) (Version 2.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24116042

distribution.name: legal-prices.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: legal-prices.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: legal-prices-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in legal-prices-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to legal-prices.csv on id.

recordSet.name: legal-prices
recordSet.description: The records of Legal-services prices and jobs, monthly (BLS CPI, PPI and CES), one per CSV row.

field.name: program
field.description: cpi (consumer prices), ppi (producer prices) or ces (employment)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: value
field.description: The published index value, or jobs in thousands, dollars or hours (see unit)

field.name: seasonal
field.description: SA seasonally adjusted, NSA not adjusted

field.name: preliminary
field.description: true while BLS may still revise the value

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
